subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Yumthang Valley located?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sikkim.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Yumthang Valley is located in the Sikkim state of India.
 
• Yumthang is popularly known as 'Valley of Flowers'.
 
• In the spring season, wildflowers such as primulas and Rhododendrons bathe the landscape in rich colors, making it a tourist hot spot.
 
• The Shingba Rhododendron Sanctuary over here has 24 species of Rhododendron flowers which bloom from April to May end.
